register: # SOURCE: FIMER 'SunSpec PICS' for REACT2 (SunSpec_REACT2_PICS_Rev_003.xlsx, minimum inverter firmware 2022C), a vendor conformance statement. Every address, type, unit, scale-factor name, access flag and enumeration below comes from its model sheets; points the PICS marks 'unimplemented' are left out.

# ADDRESSING: absolute 0-based wire addresses as listed in the PICS (SunSpec base 40000: the ID of the common model is at 40002). Modbus unit id 1 by default (register 40068 holds the device address). Reached natively or through a VSN300/VSN700 logger: for the logger variants use abb_fimer_vsn300_sunspec, whose base address is 0.

# SCALING: SunSpec scale factors are applied with the Context adjustment, which reads the scale-factor register beside each value (10**SF, SF from -10 to 10) so a changed scale factor is followed automatically. The scale-factor registers are published as diagnostics. If a scale factor reads 0x8000 (not implemented) the raw value is published unscaled.

# WRITABLE: points the PICS marks RW and supported are RW. Writable points are published RAW (not scaled): scaling by Context cannot be inverted on a write, so write the raw register value and apply the scale-factor register yourself. RW only records what the device allows; the app still needs transport write_enabled and the per-register W toggle in the web UI.

# NOT COVERED: the grid-support and protection parameter models 126, 127, 129, 130, 132, 135, 136, 139, 140 and 145 (several hundred RW curve and trip-limit points that change grid-code behavior), and the vendor models 65232 (almost all unimplemented on REACT2). Model 123 limit, power-factor and reactive-power controls are mapped.
# BYTE ORDER: SunSpec big-endian, high register first (the app default); no Register_Endian adjustment is needed. Energy counters are acc32/acc64.
